group_key: experiment; IM-01R normal run split chronologically (see deviation)

segment.basis: CYCLE, on rows present in both hfdata.csv and interim/IM-01R_sensor.parquet
segment.rule: chronological 60/20/20 with a 2500-tick (5 s) gap at each boundary

note: WITHHELD. Never read by anything but eval.py. Not packaged into portal_upload.zip.
split_hash_method: sha256 of json.dumps([train.units, val.units, test.units], sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":"))
deviation: IM-01R (the only normal run of the tool-wear program) spans train/val/test by time, against time-series-ml "never let one unit span train and test". Chosen so val and test each hold a same-program normal beside a worn trial; the alternative rewards a program-identity shortcut. Risk: test-normal is the tail of a run whose head was trained on, which can flatter specificity. Mitigation: 5 s gaps; the window length chosen at M7 must be <= 2500 ticks; ml-eval-reviewer to check at M8.
